status: offline simulation pilot; no production detector, PnP, tracker or fire-control integration
question: Can one joint network predict a transferable 8-D correction for the detector's four raw corners and improve the unchanged free-IPPE pose chain?
input_allowlist: features derived only from the raw quadrilateral: center, centered shape, scale, aspect and orientation
input_forbidden: session, segment, truth slot or association fields
PnP output, future truth or prediction horizon
label: exact_projected_corners_px - raw_detector_corners_px

model.loss: SmoothL1 on train-standardized signed corner residuals

split_contract.inner_validation: one deterministic complete training group, never a random frame split
split_contract.ensemble: mean of the three seed predictions; standard deviation retained as uncertainty evidence

baselines: train-fold ridge residual mapping using the identical observable features

pnp_contract.solver: unchanged production-matched cv2 SOLVEPNP_IPPE with Point2f/Point3f, 135x55 mm object, lowest reprojection candidate
pnp_contract.camera_matrix_and_distortion: exact exposure observation metadata; not model input
pnp_contract.required_raw_parity: recomputed raw arm must reproduce the retained production-matched arm rows before network conclusions are accepted

metrics.corner: complete paired 8-D and per-corner empirical distributions, mean/P10/P25/P50/P75/P90/P95/P99/max and CDF gates
metrics.pnp: 3-D, camera-lateral, absolute-depth, reprojection and paired improve/worsen distributions
metrics.reporting_unit: point, detection, held group and held session

pilot_acceptance: primary OOF joint-network corner P50, P90 and P95 are all lower than raw and current refinement
primary OOF selected PnP 3-D and camera-lateral P50, P90 and P95 are all no worse than raw
stress leave-session-out reports the same metrics without being hidden by the primary result
every prediction row, fold assignment, checkpoint hash and failed run is retained
boundary: Passing this pilot only authorizes a new simulation image/heatmap collection and image-conditioned network experiment; it does not authorize real-car or online use.
